```text
### Per-Widget Details

#### lrs/add-line-event
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (handles JimuMapView binding, route/network/event layer selection, dual mode UI for single/multiple events)
- **Setting:** setting.tsx + concurrency-settings.tsx, display-settings.tsx, layer-config.tsx, referent-settings.tsx, default-settings.tsx (comprehensive config UI)
- **Config:** config.ts (TypeScript interfaces: Config, SettingsPerView, ReferentConfig; OperationType enum)
- **Message/Action:** 3 data-actions: addLineEvent, addLineEventFrom, addLineEventTo (route-based event addition)
- **Custom hooks:** use-data-source-exist.tsx (common utility)
- **Utility folders:** common/ (utils.ts for settings construction), data-source/, utilities/ (formatting, state helpers)
- **Reusable components:** ReferentItemConfig (settings component), GraphicsLayerManager integration
- **Notable:** Most complex LRS widget with multi-variant actions; uses MapViewLoader and ModeType patterns for dynamic map configuration; GraphicsLayerManager for rendering line events

#### lrs/add-point-event
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (simpler: point event creation via JimuMapView)
- **Setting:** setting.tsx + default-settings.tsx, layer-config.tsx, referent-settings.tsx
- **Config:** config.ts (similar structure to add-line-event, reuses SettingsPerView)
- **Message/Action:** 1 data-action: addPointEvent (point event creation trigger)
- **Custom hooks:** use-data-source-exist.tsx (common)
- **Utility folders:** common/, data-source/
- **Notable:** Streamlined version of add-line-event; single action variant; shares LRS store and common infrastructure

#### lrs/dynamic-segmentation
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (routing and segmentation analysis), components/, state/, utils/, lib/
- **Setting:** setting.tsx + display-settings.tsx, default-settings.tsx
- **Config:** config.ts, constants.ts (DynSegFields, UI dimensions for ruler/track/icon)
- **Message/Action:** 1 data-action: dynSeg (dynamic segmentation via route)
- **State management:** DynSegRuntimeStateProvider (complex state provider for segmentation analysis)
- **Utility folders:** utils/ (diagram-utils, edit-utils, feature-layer-utils, map-utils, service-utils, table-utils, iconUtils), lib/ (styling)
- **Notable:** Most feature-rich LRS widget; includes ruler widget, edit operations, multi-layer analysis; excludeDataActions filter (elevation-profile, near-me, directions); canGenerateMultipleOutputDataSources=true

#### lrs/merge-events
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (event merging operations), components/, constants.ts, data-source/
- **Setting:** setting.tsx + default-settings.tsx, layer-config.tsx, referent-settings.tsx
- **Config:** config.ts (reuses SettingsPerView)
- **Message/Action:** 1 data-action: mergeEvents
- **Utility folders:** common/ (utils.ts)
- **Notable:** Lightweight LRS action widget; applies merge operations to selected event features; uses GraphicsLayerManager for visualization

#### lrs/split-event
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (event splitting on routes), components/, constants.ts, data-source/, utilities/
- **Setting:** setting.tsx + default-settings.tsx, layer-config.tsx, referent-settings.tsx
- **Config:** config.ts (reuses SettingsPerView)
- **Message/Action:** 1 data-action: splitEvent (splits LRS events at specified locations)
- **Custom hooks:** mapExtraStateProps (event selection state binding)
- **Notable:** Mirrors add-line-event structure but for splitting; GraphicsLayerManager for split visualization; handles event coordinates and route positioning

#### geobim/document-explorer
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (ACC document/folder display), components/, hooks/, providers/ (DocumentsProvider)
- **Setting:** setting.tsx (minimal - just map widget selection)
- **Config:** config.ts (DOCUMENT_VIEWER_WIDGET_ID_CONFIG_KEY reference)
- **Message/Action:** None (empty messageActions/publishMessages arrays)
- **Custom hooks:** use-document-explorer.tsx (main hook), use-tree-document.tsx, use-tree-node.tsx (tree navigation)
- **Providers:** DocumentsProvider, GeoBIMProvider (shared context for Autodesk connections)
- **Notable:** Pulls documents/folders from Autodesk Construction Cloud; useMapWidgetIds binding; useSharedMessages for i18n; FeatureServiceErrors handling; requireLicense=Autodesk

#### geobim/link-explorer
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (linked document display for map features), components/, hooks/, styles.ts
- **Setting:** setting.tsx (map widget + optional document-viewer widget selection)
- **Config:** config.ts (DOCUMENT_VIEWER_WIDGET_ID_CONFIG_KEY, optional viewer integration)
- **Message/Action:** None (empty messageActions/publishMessages arrays)
- **Custom hooks:** hooks/ (use-tree-node.tsx for tree state)
- **Notable:** Displays ACC documents linked to selected map features; requires feature selection + Autodesk license; optional integration with document-viewer widget

#### layout/accordion
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (AccordionLayoutViewer/Builder via builderSupportModules)
- **Setting:** setting.tsx
- **Config:** config.ts, quickstyles.ts (accordion-specific quick-style presets)
- **Message/Action:** CONTEXT_TOOL extensions (quick-style, add-widget), APP_CONFIG_OPERATIONS
- **Notable:** forbidOneByOneEffect=true (prevents cascade animations); supportAutoSize=true; accordion type layout with collapsible panels; builder support module for drag-drop editing

#### layout/column
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (ColumnLayoutViewer/Builder)

- **Message/Action:** CONTEXT_TOOL (add-widget only)
- **Notable:** Simple vertical stacking layout; supports child widgets; builder support for editing

#### layout/fixed
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx only (no setting page, no config file)

- **Config:** None (hasConfig=false)
- **Message/Action:** None

#### layout/flowrow

#### layout/grid
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (GridLayoutViewer/Builder, minimal)
- **Setting:** setting.tsx
- **Config:** Config inferred from layouts (no explicit config.ts)
- **Message/Action:** None

#### layout/sidebar
- **Runtime:** widget.tsx (SidebarLayout custom component), layout/ (custom runtime/builder layout), message-actions/, tools/
- **Setting:** setting.tsx
- **Config:** config.ts (IMSidebarConfig with direction, defaultState, color config), version-manager.ts (1.8.0 upgrade logic for colors)
- **Message/Action:** 2 message-actions (toggle-sidebar, open-sidebar with optional settings), APP_CONFIG_OPERATIONS, type definitions
- **Custom state:** mapExtraStateProps binds widgetsState.collapse for collapse state
- **Notable:** Most complex layout; dual fixed layouts (FIRST/SECOND); version manager for config migration; message-action handlers for toggle/open from other widgets; sidebar visibility state managed via Redux; SidebarLayout runtime and builder modules

---

### Cross-Widget Patterns

**LRS Group Pattern:**
All 5 LRS widgets share:
- Dependency on `jimu-arcgis` (JimuMapView binding)
- REDUX_STORE `lrs-store` extension (shared state management)
- Import from `widgets/shared-code/lrs` (GraphicsLayerManager, LrsLayer utilities, MapViewLoader)
- `jimu-for-builder` for settings (getAppConfigAction)
- Data-action driven (1-3 actions per widget)
- SettingsPerView config model for multi-map support
- Common utilities in src/common/ (constructSettingsPerView, setValuesForView)
- All mark `notSupportAGOL: true`

**GeoBIM Group Pattern:**
Both GeoBIM widgets share:
- Dependency on `jimu-arcgis`
- REDUX_STORE `geobim-store` extension
- Import from `widgets/shared-code/geobim` (GeoBIMProvider, useSharedMessages, DocumentViewerWidgetList)
- Require license: Autodesk
- useMapWidgetIds binding (feature-linked or document browsing)
- Empty messageActions/publishMessages (no inter-widget messaging)
- Custom hooks for state management (use-document-explorer, use-tree-node, etc.)
- useSharedMessages pattern for i18n

**Layout Group Pattern:**
All 6 layout widgets:
- widgetType: LAYOUT
- hasBuilderSupportModule: true (LayoutViewer + LayoutBuilder pair)
- builderSupportModules.widgetModules.[LayoutType]Builder pattern
- Import from `jimu-layouts/layout-runtime` (LayoutViewer components)
- Use `window.jimuConfig.isInBuilder` to select runtime vs. builder component
- layouts object passed from ExB (single layout or multi-layout like sidebar)
- WidgetPlaceholder for empty state
- Variation: sidebar is most complex (message-actions, version-manager, dual layouts, state binding)
```

````text
# OTB Widget: arcgis/legend

Online widget doc: https://developers.arcgis.com/experience-builder/guide/legend-widget/

## Purpose

Displays a legend for layers in a connected Map widget. Supports two style modes: classic (single list) and card (carousel-based layout with auto/side-by-side/stack options). Provides configuration for layer visibility filtering, basemap inclusion, and layer-level customization to show/hide specific layers and runtime-added layers.

## Source paths inspected

- [manifest.json](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/manifest.json)
- [src/config.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/config.ts)
- [src/runtime/widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx)
- [src/runtime/lib/style.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/lib/style.ts)
- [src/setting/setting.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/setting/setting.tsx)
- [src/setting/lib/style.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/setting/lib/style.ts)
- [src/setting/components/group-radios.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/setting/components/group-radios.tsx)
- [src/version-manager.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/version-manager.ts)

**SKIPPED:** test files (per user direction)

## Architecture overview

**Class-based React component** (PureComponent) with these responsibility zones:

1. **Map binding**: Uses `JimuMapViewComponent` to connect to a single Map widget (via `useMapWidgetIds[0]`). Tracks `activeJmv: JimuMapView` in state.
2. **Legend creation**: Lazily loads the Esri `Legend` JSAPI widget via `loadArcGISJSAPIModules` on first map attach. Each map change destroys the old legend and creates a new one.
3. **Layer visibility filtering**: Subscribes to `legend.activeLayerInfos` changes via `reactiveUtils.on()` to filter displayed layers based on config settings (runtime-added layers, per-layer selection, definition expressions).
4. **Style management**: Maps config choices (`cardStyle`, `cardLayout`, custom background/font) into Esri Legend style objects (`classic` or `{type: 'card', layout: ...}`). Recalculates layout on resize for auto mode.
5. **Responsive behavior**: Wraps legend container in `ReactResizeDetector` to trigger `onResize` handler when widget width changes; width <= 600px triggers stack layout.

Config-driven features: `showBaseMap`, `legendMode` (ShowVisible/ShowWithinExtent/ShowAll), `respectLayerDefinitionExp`, custom styling.

## Reusable patterns found

### Pattern 1: JimuMapViewComponent + onActiveViewChange + destroyLegend

**File:** [widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L305-L315)

The cleanest template for map-connected widgets. Listen for map changes, destroy old JSAPI widget, create new one:

```typescript
onActiveViewChange = async (jimuMapView: JimuMapView) => {
  if (jimuMapView && jimuMapView.view) {
    await this.createLegend(jimuMapView.view)
    this.setState({
      loadStatus: LoadStatus.Fulfilled,
      activeJmv: jimuMapView
    })
  } else {
    this.destroyLegend()  // Important: clean up on disconnect
  }
}

destroyLegend = () => {
  this.legend && !this.legend.destroyed && this.legend.destroy()
}
```

**Why:** Ensures single Legend instance per map view; no memory leaks on map swap or widget removal.

### Pattern 2: reactiveUtils.on() for legend layer filtering

**File:** [widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L86-L115)

Watch Esri Legend's active layer list and filter based on config. The reactiveUtils subscription is NOT manually cleaned up (UNVERIFIED if destroyed with legend widget):

```typescript
customizeLegends = () => {
  if (this.props.config.customizeLayerOptions?.[this.state.activeJmv?.id]?.isEnabled) {
    reactiveUtils.on(() => this.legend.activeLayerInfos, 'change', (event) => {
      const showSet = new Set(this.props.config.customizeLayerOptions?.[this.state.activeJmv?.id]?.showJimuLayerViewIds)
      for (const item of this.legend.activeLayerInfos) {
        const jlvId = this.state.activeJmv.getJimuLayerViewIdByAPILayer(item.layer)
        if (!showSet.has(jlvId)) {
          this.legend.activeLayerInfos.remove(item)
        }
      }
    })
  }
}
```

**Why:** Reactive filtering without manual polling; syncs ExB layer choices to JSAPI legend view.

### Pattern 3: Responsive card layout with auto breakpoint

**File:** [widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L212-L237)

Calculate legend style based on widget width. ReactResizeDetector triggers `onResize`:

```typescript
onResize = ({ width, height }) => {
  this.currentWidth = width
  if (this.legend && this.props.config.cardLayout === 'auto') {
    const style = this.calculateStyle()
    this.legend.style = style
  }
}

calculateStyle = () => {
  const currentWidth = this.currentWidth || 100000
  if (this.props.config.cardStyle) {
    let layout
    if (!this.props.config.cardLayout || this.props.config.cardLayout === 'auto') {
      if (currentWidth <= 600) {
        layout = 'stack'
      } else {
        layout = 'side-by-side'
      }
    } else {
      layout = this.props.config.cardLayout
    }
    return { type: 'card' as const, layout: layout }
  }
  return 'classic'
}
```

**Why:** Breakpoint at 600px for mobile; auto mode makes legend responsive without explicit media queries.

### Pattern 4: LayerSetting + customizeLayerOptions config shape

**File:** [setting.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/setting/setting.tsx#L400-L425)

Use jimu-ui's LayerSetting component to build a layer picker UI. Binds to config shape:

```typescript
config.customizeLayerOptions[jmvId] = {
  isEnabled: boolean
  showJimuLayerViewIds: string[]  // JimuLayerView IDs to display
  showRuntimeAddedLayers: boolean
}
```

Called from setting:

```typescript
<LayerSetting
  mapWidgetId={this.props.useMapWidgetIds?.[0]}
  mapViewId={this.state.activeCustomizeJmvId}
  isCustomizeEnabled={this.getActiveCustomizeStatus()}
  onToggleCustomize={this.onCustomizeLayerChange}
  onSelectedLayerIdChange={this.onLayerIdChange}
  selectedValues={this.getSelectedValues()}
  hideLayers={this.hideLayers}
/>
```

**Why:** Reusable layer selector; handles tree traversal and JimuLayerView introspection for you.

## Builder vs runtime split

**Runtime** ([widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx))
- Renders the JSAPI Legend widget in a container ref
- Listens to map changes via JimuMapViewComponent
- Applies config choices (style, baseMap, legendMode, layer filters)
- Cleans up on view/widget destruction

**Builder** ([setting.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/setting/setting.tsx))
- MapWidgetSelector for map binding
- SettingSection panels for cardStyle, cardLayout, legendMode, baseMap toggle
- LayerSetting component for per-layer customization
- ThemeColorPicker for custom font/background (behind Advanced toggle)
- Calls `onSettingChange` to persist config via Redux

Both call the same `getStyle()` function for theme-aware styling.

## Lifecycle and cleanup

**Mount/Attach**
1. Constructor sets state to `LoadStatus.Pending`
2. Render mounts `<JimuMapViewComponent>` (hidden div)
3. JimuMapViewComponent fires `onActiveViewChange` callback when map view attaches
4. `onActiveViewChange` calls `createLegend()` (async), sets state to Fulfilled

**Update**
- `componentDidUpdate` fires after config prop change; calls `createLegend()` again to refresh legend

**Resize**
- ReactResizeDetector calls `onResize({ width, height })` when widget container resizes
- If cardLayout is 'auto', recalculates style and updates `legend.style`

**Cleanup / Unmount**
- When no map widget selected or component unmounts: `destroyLegend()` is called (checked in render)
- `destroyLegend()` calls `legend.destroy()` if not already destroyed
- **UNVERIFIED:** `reactiveUtils.on()` watchers are not explicitly removed; assumed to be cleaned up when legend is destroyed

**Quote from [widget.tsx#46-51](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L46-L51):**
```typescript
componentDidUpdate (prevProps: Readonly<WidgetProps>, prevState: Readonly<WidgetState>, snapshot?: any): void {
  // Refresh legend widget when the config changes
  if (this.state.activeJmv) {
    this.createLegend(this.state.activeJmv.view)
  }
}
```

## Manifest/config requirements

**Manifest** ([manifest.json](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/manifest.json))
- `name`: "legend"
- `version`: "1.20.0"
- `exbVersion`: "1.20.0"
- `dependency`: "jimu-arcgis" (declares JSAPI imports)
- `defaultSize`: `{width: 400, height: 400}`
- `properties.coverLayoutBackground`: true (legend can cover widget background)
- `properties.flipIcon`: true (legend icon flips on RTL)

**Config Schema** ([config.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/config.ts))
```typescript
interface Config {
  showBaseMap?: boolean  // default false; show/hide basemap legend
  cardStyle?: boolean    // default false; card mode vs classic
  cardLayout?: 'auto' | 'side-by-side' | 'stack'  // card layout choice
  legendMode?: ELegendMode  // ShowVisible | ShowWithinExtent | ShowAll
  respectLayerDefinitionExp?: boolean  // UNVERIFIED: appears unused (commented out in setting)
  style: Style  // custom styling
  customizeLayerOptions?: {
    [jimuMapViewId: string]: CustomizeLayerOption
  }
}

enum ELegendMode {
  ShowVisible = 'show-visible',
  ShowWithinExtent = 'show-within-extent',
  ShowAll = 'show-all'
}

interface CustomizeLayerOption {
  isEnabled: boolean
  showRuntimeAddedLayers?: boolean
  showJimuLayerViewIds?: string[]
}

interface Style {
  useCustom: boolean
  background: BackgroundStyle
  fontColor: string
}
```

## Gotchas

1. **No cleanup of reactiveUtils.on watchers**: [widget.tsx#86](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L86) subscribes to `legend.activeLayerInfos` changes but does NOT call a remove handle. Assumed auto-cleaned when legend is destroyed, but UNVERIFIED.

2. **Card style conditionally hides at <= 600px**: Width-based breakpoint in [calculateStyle()](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L212-L237) forces 'stack' layout below 600px; may not match your app's breakpoints.

3. **customizeLayerOptions keyed by jmvId, not dataSourceId**: [config.ts#20](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/config.ts) nests config under jimuMapViewId. Each map view instance gets separate layer settings. If a widget is wired to multiple maps, each map has independent layer visibility config.

4. **getAllChildActiveInfos recursion without depth limit**: [widget.tsx#120-130](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L120-L130) recursively collects all child layer infos; deeply nested layers could cause perf issues (UNVERIFIED in practice).

5. **respectLayerDefinitionExp option commented out**: [setting.tsx lines 370-379](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/setting/setting.tsx#L370-L379) shows a Switch for this option is commented out; config.ts still defines it. Unknown if it's planned for removal or re-enable.

6. **No explicit error handling for JSAPI load**: [createLegend()](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L62-L81) awaits `loadArcGISJSAPIModules` and `view.when()` without try-catch; failures will silently leave legend in Pending state.

7. **Builder always calls configLegend**: [widget.tsx#296](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L296) has a guard: `if (window.jimuConfig.isInBuilder) this.configLegend()`. This applies config during builder render even before map attaches; may cause stale state if config is changed rapidly in settings panel.

## Useful snippets and functions

### Snippet 1: destroyLegend pattern

**File:** [widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L54-L56)

Safe destruction of JSAPI widget:

```typescript
destroyLegend = () => {
  this.legend && !this.legend.destroyed && this.legend.destroy()
}
```

### Snippet 2: getAllChildActiveInfos recursive traversal

**File:** [widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L120-L130)

Recursively flatten all child layers from a top-level ActiveLayerInfo:

```typescript
getAllChildActiveInfos = (activeInfo: __esri.ActiveLayerInfo, result: __esri.ActiveLayerInfo[] = []) => {
  if (activeInfo.children) {
    for (const childInfo of activeInfo.children) {
      result.push(childInfo)
      this.getAllChildActiveInfos(childInfo, result)
    }
  }
  return result
}
```

### Snippet 3: isParentVisible recursive parent check

**File:** [widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L151-L173)

Walk layer parents and check if all are in the show set:

```typescript
isParentVisible (layer: __esri.Layer | __esri.Sublayer, showSet: Set<string>) {
  const allParentLayers = getParents(layer)
  if (allParentLayers.length === 0) {
    return true
  }
  for (const parentLayer of allParentLayers) {
    const parentJlvId = this.state.activeJmv.getJimuLayerViewIdByAPILayer(parentLayer)
    if (!showSet.has(parentJlvId)) {
      return false
    }
  }
  return true

  function getParents (layer: __esri.Layer | __esri.Sublayer) {
    const ret = []
    let currLayer: any = layer
    // Skip ground
    while (currLayer.parent && currLayer.parent.parent) {
      ret.push(currLayer.parent)
      currLayer = currLayer.parent
    }
    return ret
  }
}
```

### Snippet 4: configLegend legend style + mode mapping

**File:** [widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L203-L217)

Map config choices to JSAPI legend properties:

```typescript
configLegend = () => {
  if (this.legend) {
    const basemapLegendVisible = this.props.config.showBaseMap
    this.legend.style = this.calculateStyle()
    this.legend.basemapLegendVisible = basemapLegendVisible
    const legendMode = this.props.config.legendMode

    if (legendMode === ELegendMode.ShowAll) {
      this.legend.respectLayerVisibility = false
    } else if (legendMode === ELegendMode.ShowWithinExtent) {
      this.legend.hideLayersNotInCurrentView = true
    }
  }
}
```

**File:** [group-radios.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/setting/components/group-radios.tsx)

### Function 4: getStyle theme + custom styling

**File:** [runtime/lib/style.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/legend/src/runtime/lib/style.ts)

Apply theme + custom colors to legend container:

```typescript
export function getStyle (theme: IMThemeVariables, style: Style): SerializedStyles {
  const fillStyleCss = styleUtils.toCSSStyle({ background: style.background }) as any
  const fontColor = style.fontColor || theme.sys.color.surface.paperText
  const root = style.background?.color || 'transparent'

  return css`
    .widget-legend {
      background-color: ${root};
      --calcite-color-text-2: ${fontColor};
      // ... carousel, card, heading styles
    }
  `
}
```
````

```text
# OTB Widget: arcgis/coordinates

Online widget doc: https://developers.arcgis.com/experience-builder/guide/coordinates-widget/

## Purpose
```

````text
Display coordinates at pointer position or clicked location on a map/scene. Supports multiple coordinate systems (geographic/projected), formats (DD/DMS/DDM/MGRS/USNG), multi-datum transformation, and 3D elevation/eye altitude readouts. Runtime: real-time pointer tracking or click-to-capture. Builder: configure coordinate systems, units, display order, widget style (classic/modern), and datum transformations.

## Source paths inspected

- Manifest: [manifest.json](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/manifest.json)
- Config interface: [src/config.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/config.ts)
- Runtime widget: [src/runtime/widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx) (900+ lines)

- Runtime style: [src/runtime/style.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/style.ts)
- Utilities: [src/utils/index.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/utils/index.ts) (degree/unit conversions)

- Config JSON: [config.json](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/config.json) (default config)

## Architecture overview

```
coordinates widget
├── Runtime (widget.tsx)
│   ├── JimuMapViewComponent: bind selected map
│   ├── GraphicsLayer: renders location marker

│   ├── coordinateFormatter: MGRS/USNG encoding

│   └── Components: TextAutoFit (scales coord text), ElevEye (3D elev + eye altitude)
├── Setting panels (setting.tsx + system-config.tsx)
│   ├── MapWidgetSelector: pick map(s) to bind
│   ├── Coordinate system list: add/edit/remove systems
│   ├── SystemConfig: WKID input, display unit select, elevation unit, datum transforms
│   └── Display options: decimal places, separators, XY/YX order, classic/modern style
└── Builder operations: BUILDER_OPERATIONS extension for translation keys

hooks.useUpdateEffect(() => {
  const view = currentJimuMapView?.view
  const viewTypeIsThree = view?.type === '3d'
  if (enableRealtime) {
    clickListener.current?.remove()
    moveListener.current?.remove()
    moveListener.current = view?.on('pointer-move', (event) => {
      const point = view.toMap({ x: event.x, y: event.y })
      const threeDPoint = { x: event?.native?.pageX, y: event?.native?.pageY }
      onMouseMove(point, viewTypeIsThree ? threeDPoint : undefined)
    })
  } else {
    // ... click handler when locate mode active
    if (locateActive) {
      clickListener.current = view?.on('click', (event) => {
        const threeDPoint = { x: event?.native?.pageX, y: event?.native?.pageY }
        onMapClick(event, viewTypeIsThree ? threeDPoint : undefined)
      })
    }
  }
}, [currentJimuMapView, locateActive, enableRealtime, selectedSystemId, coordinateSystem, coordinateDecimal, altitudeDecimal, showSeparators, displayOrder])
```

**Key insight:** Toggle between pointer-move (real-time) and click (locate) modes. Capture raw page coordinates for 3D hit testing. Clean up listeners on deps change.

### 2. Basemap and view property observation with reactiveUtils.watch

**Source:** [src/runtime/widget.tsx:571-589](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L571-L589)

```typescript
React.useEffect(() => {
  const view = currentJimuMapView?.view
  if (!view) return
  // monitor basemap change
  const watchBaseMap = reactiveUtils.watch(() => view?.map?.basemap, () => {
    (view as any).cursor = 'default'
    if (!view?.basemapView) return
    const baseMapView = view.basemapView?.view
    mapWkid.current = baseMapView?.spatialReference?.wkid
    mapPortalId.current = (baseMapView?.map as any)?.portalItem?.id
    checkBasemapUnitsSetTips()
    checkSystemSetTips()
    resetAllGeoInfo()
    if (markerGraphic.current) {
      graphicsLayer.current?.remove(markerGraphic.current)
    }
  })
  return () => {
    watchBaseMap.remove()
  }
}, [currentJimuMapView, checkBasemapUnitsSetTips, checkSystemSetTips])
```

**Key insight:** Monitor external view state (basemap) changes. Must call `.remove()` in cleanup to prevent double-listeners. Access basemap spatial reference via `view.basemapView.view.spatialReference`.

### 3. Multi-coordinate-system output formatting

**Source:** [src/runtime/widget.tsx:715-780](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L715-L780)

Three parallel display paths based on output unit:

**MGRS/USNG (loads formatter):**
```typescript
const displayUsngOrMgrs = (unit: 'MGRS' | 'USNG', normalizedPoint) => {
  coordinateFormatter.load().then(() => {
    const nlsUnit = unitToNls(unit)
    if (unit === 'MGRS') {
      const mgrs = coordinateFormatter.toMgrs(normalizedPoint, 'automatic', 5)
      setGeoInfo(`${mgrs} ${nlsUnit}`)
    } else if (unit === 'USNG') {
      const usng = coordinateFormatter.toUsng(normalizedPoint, 5)
      setGeoInfo(`${usng} ${nlsUnit}`)
    }
  })
}
```

**Geographic (DMS/DDM/DD, unit conversion):**
```typescript
const displayDegOrDms = (unit: string, normalizedPoint, mapIsMercator?: boolean, outCrsUnit?: string) => {
  let { x, y } = normalizedPoint
  const orderXy = displayOrder === DisplayOrderType.xy
  const selectedSystem = coordinateSystem.find(item => item.id === selectedSystemId)
  const { crs } = selectedSystem
  const defaultUnit = outCrsUnit || getCSUnitByCrs(crs)
  const unitRate = getUnitRate(defaultUnit, unit, mapIsMercator)
  x = x * unitRate
  y = y * unitRate
  if (unit === 'DEGREE_MINUTE_SECONDS') {
    x = degToDMS(x, 'LON', coordinateDecimal, showSeparators)
    y = degToDMS(y, 'LAT', coordinateDecimal, showSeparators)
    orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${x} ${y}`) : setGeoInfo(`${y} ${x}`)
  } else if (unit === 'DEGREES_DECIMAL_MINUTES') {
    x = degToDDM(x, coordinateDecimal, showSeparators, 'longitude')
    y = degToDDM(y, coordinateDecimal, showSeparators, 'latitude')
    orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${x} ${y}`) : setGeoInfo(`${y} ${x}`)
  } else {
    const nlsUnit = unitToNls(unit)
    orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(x)} ${toFormat(y)} ${nlsUnit}`) : setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(y)} ${toFormat(x)} ${nlsUnit}`)
  }
}
```

**Projected (meter/feet/etc.):**
```typescript
const displayProject = (unit: string, normalizedPoint, mapIsMercator?: boolean, outCrsUnit?: string) => {
  let { x, y } = normalizedPoint
  const selectedSystem = coordinateSystem.find(item => item.id === selectedSystemId)
  const { crs } = selectedSystem
  const defaultUnit = outCrsUnit || getCSUnitByCrs(crs)
  const unitRate = getUnitRate(defaultUnit, unit, mapIsMercator)
  x = x * unitRate
  y = y * unitRate
  const nlsUnit = unitToNls(unit)
  const orderXy = displayOrder === DisplayOrderType.xy
  orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(x)} ${toFormat(y)} ${nlsUnit}`) : setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(y)} ${toFormat(x)} ${nlsUnit}`)
}
```

**Key insight:** Route output via unit type. Use `coordinateFormatter.load()` once for MGRS/USNG (lazy load). Handle unit conversion and direction order (XY vs YX) per format. Normalize point and use custom degree formatters (DMS/DDM).

## Manifest/config requirements

**manifest.json structure:**

```json
{
  "name": "coordinates",
  "label": "Coordinates",
  "type": "widget",
  "version": "1.20.0",
  "exbVersion": "1.20.0",
  "defaultSize": { "width": 242, "height": 140 },
  "properties": { "hasSettingPage": true, "defaultInControllerUx": "offPanel" },
  "extensions": [
    {
      "name": "builderOperations",
      "point": "BUILDER_OPERATIONS",
      "uri": "tools/builder-operations"
    }
  ],
  "dependency": "jimu-arcgis"
}
```

**Config interface (config.ts):**

```typescript
export interface Config {
  coordinateSystem: ImmutableArray<CoordinateConfig>  // array of coordinate system configs
  coordinateDecimal: number                             // decimal places (e.g., 3)
  altitudeDecimal: number                               // decimal places for elevation (e.g., 2)
  showSeparators: boolean                               // thousands separator (1,234 vs 1234)
  displayOrder: DisplayOrderType                        // XY or YX
  widgetStyle: WidgetStyleType                          // CLASSIC or MODERN
  mapInfo?: MapInfo                                      // map 1 spatial ref metadata (optional)
  mapInfo2?: MapInfo                                     // map 2 spatial ref metadata (optional, dual-map)
}

export interface CoordinateConfig {
  id: string
  name: string                                          // user-friendly label
  wkid: string                                          // spatial reference WKID (e.g., '4326')
  crs?: any                                             // full CRS object from wkidLookup
  displayUnit: string                                   // output unit (DECIMAL_DEGREES, MGRS, METER, etc.)
  elevationUnit?: ElevationUnitType                     // METRIC or IMPERIAL
  datumWkid?: string                                    // datum transform for map 1
  datumName?: string                                    // human label
  transformForward?: boolean                            // datum direction flag
  datumWkid2?: string                                   // datum transform for map 2
  datumName2?: string
  transformForward2?: boolean
}
```

## Gotchas

1. **coordinateFormatter.load() is async and must be awaited** - MGRS/USNG formatting fails silently if not loaded. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:728](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L728)

2. **Point.normalize() required for coordinates near date line** - Longitude wraps to -180/180 range. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:867](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L867)

3. **Basemap vs basemapView spatial reference** - Use `view.basemapView.view.spatialReference.wkid`, not `view.basemap`. The basemap object does not expose spatial reference. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:582](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L582)

4. **Marker symbol SVG path is relative to runtime** - [src/runtime/widget.tsx:649-651](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L649-L651) uses `require('./assets/pin-exb.svg')`. Ensure SVG asset exists in runtime/assets/.

5. **Portal ID (mapPortalId.current) switches on basemap change** - Used to route datum transforms in dual-map config. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:583](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L583)

6. **3D scene elevation (z) requires hit test or ground view state** - Use view.hitTest({ x, y }) to get surface elevation at screen coordinate. Camera eye altitude stored separately (UNVERIFIED - [src/runtime/widget.tsx:830-850](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L830-L850)).

7. **Widget size auto-sizing affects text scaling** - TextAutoFit component scales down text if widget height/width < content. Set widgetSizeAuto state based on layout item settings. [src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx)

8. **Datum WKID lookup requires isValidWkid check** - System-config.tsx validates WKID before calling wkidLookup. Invalid WKID resets datum fields. [src/setting/system-config.tsx:85-125](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/setting/system-config.tsx#L85-L125)

9. **Display unit type determines projection path** - Geographic units route to degToDMS/degToDDM/normalize; projected units route to unit conversion. MGRS/USNG route separately (require coordinateFormatter.load()). [src/runtime/widget.tsx:728-780](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L728-L780)

10. **Two-map mode (mapInfo + mapInfo2) requires portalId routing** - Used to apply different datum transforms per map. If maps have same spheroid, datum transforms not required. [src/setting/system-config.tsx:105-125](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/setting/system-config.tsx#L105-L125)

## Useful snippets and functions

### Degree to DMS (Degrees-Minutes-Seconds)

Source: [src/utils/index.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/utils/index.ts)

```typescript
export const degToDMS = (decDeg, decDir: 'LAT' | 'LON', decimal: number, showSeparators: boolean) => {
  let d = Math.abs(decDeg)
  let deg = Math.floor(d)
  d = d - deg
  let min = Math.floor(d * 60)
  let sec = (d - min / 60) * 60 * 60
  if (sec === 60) {
    min++
    sec = 0
  }
  if (min === 60) {
    deg++
    min = 0
  }
  const fixedSec = localizeNumberBySettingInfo(sec, {
    places: decimal,
    digitSeparator: showSeparators
  })
  const minStr = min < 10 ? `0${min}` : min
  const secStr = sec < 10 ? `0${fixedSec}` : fixedSec
  const dir = (decDir === 'LAT') ? (decDeg < 0 ? 'S' : 'N') : (decDeg < 0 ? 'W' : 'E')
  return `${deg}°${minStr}′${secStr}″${dir}`
}
```

### Degree to DDM (Degrees-Decimal-Minutes)

Source: [src/utils/index.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/utils/index.ts)

```typescript
export const degToDDM = (decDeg, decimal: number, showSeparators: boolean, type: 'longitude' | 'latitude') => {
  const tailTag = type === 'longitude'
    ? (decDeg < 0 ? 'W' : 'E')
    : (decDeg < 0 ? 'S' : 'N')
  let d = Math.abs(decDeg)
  let deg = Math.floor(d)
  d = d - deg
  let min = Math.floor(d * 60)
  let sec = Math.floor((d - min / 60) * 60 * 60)
  if (sec === 60) {
    min++
    sec = 0
  }
  if (min === 60) {
    deg++
    min = 0
  }
  const dm = localizeNumberBySettingInfo((min + (sec / 60)), {
    places: decimal,
    digitSeparator: showSeparators
  })
  return `${deg}°${dm}′${tailTag}`
}
```

### TextAutoFit component (scales coordinate text to fit widget)

Source: [src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx)

```typescript
export const TextAutoFit = React.memo((props: Props) => {
  const { text, className, widgetRect, domChange } = props
  const outerContainerDom = useRef(null)
  const textDom = useRef(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    updateText()
  }, [text, widgetRect, outerContainerDom.current?.clientWidth, outerContainerDom.current?.clientHeight, domChange])

  const updateText = () => {
    const outerWidth = outerContainerDom.current?.clientWidth
    const outerHeight = outerContainerDom.current?.clientHeight
    const textWidth = textDom.current?.clientWidth
    const textHeight = textDom.current?.clientHeight
    if (!outerWidth || !textWidth || !outerHeight || !textHeight) return
    if (textWidth !== outerWidth || textHeight !== outerHeight) {
      const widthRate = outerWidth / textWidth
      const heightRate = outerHeight / textHeight
      textDom.current.style.transform = `scale(${Math.min(widthRate, heightRate)})`
    } else {
      textDom.current.style.transform = 'none'
    }
  }

  return <div ref={outerContainerDom} css={getStyle()} className={className}>
    <div className='text' ref={textDom}>{text}</div>
  </div>
})
```

### Check if coordinate system can display in client

Source: [src/runtime/widget.tsx:654-696](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L654-L696)

```typescript
const canShowInClient = React.useCallback(async (selectedSystem: CoordinateConfig): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (!selectedSystem) return false
  const { wkid, crs } = selectedSystem
  const curWkidNum = parseInt(wkid)
  const curSr = new SpatialReference({ wkid: curWkidNum })
  const mapSr = new SpatialReference({ wkid: mapWkid.current })
  const specialCase = (mapWkid.current === 4326 && curSr.isWebMercator) ||
    (curWkidNum === 4326 && mapSr.isWebMercator)
  const curLabel = crs?.name
  const usedConfigMapInfo = getUsedMapInfo()
  const hasMap = useMapWidgetIds && useMapWidgetIds?.length > 0
  const getMapLabel = (): Promise<string> => {
    if (!mapWkid.current || !hasMap) {
      return Promise.resolve('')
    } else if (usedConfigMapInfo?.wkid && mapWkid.current === usedConfigMapInfo?.wkid) {
      return Promise.resolve(usedConfigMapInfo?.label)
    } else {
      if (!modulesLoaded) {
        return moduleLoader.loadModule<typeof JimuCoreWkid>('jimu-core/wkid').then(module => {
          wkidUtilsRef.current = module
          setModulesLoaded(true)
          const { getSRLabel } = module
          return getSRLabel(mapWkid.current)
        })
      } else {
        const { getSRLabel } = wkidUtilsRef.current
        return getSRLabel(mapWkid.current)
      }
    }
  }
  const mapLabel = await getMapLabel()
  const isSameSR = curLabel && curLabel === mapLabel
  if (isSameSR || specialCase) return true
  return false
}, [getUsedMapInfo, modulesLoaded, useMapWidgetIds])
```
````

```text
# OTB Widget: arcgis/basemap-gallery

Online widget doc: https://developers.arcgis.com/experience-builder/guide/basemap-gallery-widget/

## Purpose
```

````text
Provides a gallery UI for switching between basemaps in a connected Map widget. Supports two modes:
- **Organization**: Displays basemaps shared in the organization's portal (lazy-loaded, cached)
- **Custom**: User-curated list of basemaps, including portal items and custom basemaps from REST URLs (MapServer, ImageServer, VectorTileServer endpoints)

Filters out 3D-only basemaps when connected to 2D maps. Preserves the original basemap when switching maps and restores it on widget removal.

## Source paths inspected

```
ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/basemap-gallery/
  manifest.json
  config.json
  src/
    config.ts
    utils.ts
    runtime/
      widget.tsx (main widget component, 400+ lines)
      basemap-utils.ts (hooks & utilities)
      utils.ts (drag-drop detection)
    setting/
      setting.tsx (settings UI panel)
      utils.ts (async basemap loading)
      components/
        add-by-url.tsx (add custom basemaps from URLs)
        indicator-3d.tsx (3D basemap badge)
        custom-basemap-list.tsx
        import-basemaps.tsx
        button-with-side-popper.tsx
        placeholder.tsx
    tools/
      app-config-operations.ts (widgetWillRemove lifecycle hook)
      builder-operations.ts (translation key generation for ML)
```

**Skipped**: dist/, tests/, translations/ (i18n strings), CSS/icon assets, import-basemaps and custom-basemap-list implementation details.

## Architecture overview

### High-level flow

1. **Runtime initialization** (widget.tsx):
   - Accepts `useMapWidgetIds` prop to bind to Map widget
   - Wraps `JimuMapViewComponent` to listen for active map view changes
   - Creates an `arcgis-basemap-gallery` web component (ArcGIS JS API) dynamically via DOM
   - Manages gallery lifecycle: create, update source, handle basemap changes, cleanup

2. **Basemap source management**:
   - Creates a `LocalBasemapsSource` instance with a `Basemap[]` collection
   - Source populated via `getBasemapsForGallerySource()` which:
     - Fetches org basemaps if mode is Organization, OR
     - Loads custom basemaps if mode is Custom
   - Filters out 3D basemaps if map is 2D

3. **Caching strategy**:
   - **Org basemaps**: Cached in MutableStoreManager (heavy, time-consuming fetch)
   - **Original basemaps**: Map stored per map view ID (used to restore on view switch or widget removal)
   - **Gallery element**: Cached as `HTMLArcgisBasemapGalleryElement` (avoid recreate on widget drag/reposition)

4. **Custom basemap changes**:
   - Detects add/remove/sort via `useCustomBasemapsChange()` hook
   - Rebuilds gallery items on fly (insert, remove, update, or reorder)
   - Handles layer URL changes for "basemap from URL" items

### Component hierarchy

```
Widget (widget.tsx)
  ├─ JimuMapViewComponent (listens for onActiveViewChange)
  ├─ arcgis-basemap-gallery (web component, created in DOM)
  └─ Loading component (while fetching basemaps)

Setting (setting.tsx)
  ├─ MapWidgetSelector (choose which Map widget to bind to)
  ├─ Radio group (Organization vs Custom mode)
  ├─ ImportBasemaps (import from portal group)
  ├─ AddBasemapsByUrl (add custom from REST endpoint)
  └─ CustomBasemapList (reorderable list with edit/delete)
      └─ Indicator3d (badge for 3D basemaps)
```

## Key imports and packages

### esri modules (ArcGIS JS API)
- `esri/widgets/BasemapGallery/BasemapGalleryViewModel` - Used for `bgViewModel.basemapEquals()` equality checks
- `esri/widgets/BasemapGallery/support/LocalBasemapsSource` - Custom source for gallery
- `esri/Basemap` - Basemap class, created via `new Basemap({ portalItem: { id } })` or with baseLayers
- `esri/layers/Layer` - Generic layer loader via `Layer.fromArcGISServerUrl()`
- `esri/layers/VectorTileLayer` - For JSON/style URL basemaps

### jimu-arcgis
- `basemapUtils` - Provides:
  - `basemapUtils.isBasemap3D(basemap)` - Check if basemap is 3D-only
  - `basemapUtils.loadBasemap(basemap)` - Async load and return basemap
  - `basemapUtils.getOrgBasemaps()` - Fetch org portal basemaps
  - `basemapUtils.BasemapItem` - Portal basemap item type
- `JimuMapViewComponent` - Map binding wrapper
- `MapViewManager` - Singleton to retrieve JimuMapView by ID

### jimu-core
- `MutableStoreManager` - Persistent widget state cache
- `appConfigUtils.processResourceUrl()` - Resolve widget resource URLs
- `hooks.useUpdateEffect()` - useEffect that skips initial run
- `hooks.usePrevious()` - Track previous prop value
- `Immutable()` - Create immutable objects from config
- `SessionManager.getInstance().getMainSession()?.token` - Portal token for auth

### jimu-ui
- `Paper`, `Loading`, `WidgetPlaceholder` - Layout & loading states
- `SettingSection`, `SettingRow`, `MapWidgetSelector` - Settings UI
- `Radio`, `Label`, `Button`, `TextInput`, `TextArea`, `Checkbox` - Form controls
- `ImageSelector` - For thumbnail selection

### Type definitions
- `AllWidgetProps<IMConfig>` - Widget runtime props
- `AllWidgetSettingProps<IMConfig>` - Widget settings props
- `IMThemeVariables` - Theme object for default thumbnail SVG

## Reusable patterns found

### 1. useCache hook - Mutable state caching for heavy operations
Stores org basemaps, original basemaps per map view, and gallery element via MutableStoreManager. Includes cleanup on unmount.

### 2. Basemap equality comparison via BasemapGalleryViewModel
Cannot compare basemaps by reference; use `bgViewModel.basemapEquals()` for semantic comparison.

### 3. Dynamic web component creation and lifecycle
Creates `arcgis-basemap-gallery` element via DOM, sets `autoDestroyDisabled = true` to control lifecycle, caches element to avoid recreate.

### 4. Custom basemap change tracking with add/remove/sort differentiation
Uses `usePrevious()` to detect length changes and route to specific handlers (onAdd, onRemove, onSortOrUpdate).

### 5. getBasemap factory - Polymorphic basemap creation
Single async function that creates basemaps from either portal IDs or REST URLs, handles layer loading via `Layer.fromArcGISServerUrl()`.

### 6. Widget state persistence via AllWidgetProps.mutableStateProps
Stores widget state in MutableStoreManager keyed by widget ID; survives widget drag/reposition and map switching.

### 7. Basemap source filtering for 2D vs 3D maps
Detects `mapView.type === '3d'` and filters 3D-only basemaps for 2D views.

## Builder vs runtime split

### Setting (Builder-time)
Configuration UI in Experience Builder with MapWidgetSelector, Radio toggle (Organization vs Custom), and conditional import/add/list controls. Updates config via `onSettingChange`.

### Runtime (widget.tsx)
Displays gallery and handles basemap switching. Initializes on map bind, creates gallery from cache or fresh, updates on config/map changes.

### Config interface
```typescript
export enum BasemapsType {
  Organization = 'ORGANIZATION',
  Custom = 'CUSTOM'
}

export interface BasemapFromUrl {
  id: string
  title: string
  thumbnail?: ImageParam
  layerUrls: string[]
  disablePopup?: boolean
}

export type BasemapInfo = basemapUtils.BasemapItem | BasemapFromUrl

export interface Config {
  customBasemaps?: BasemapInfo[]
  basemapsType?: BasemapsType
}
```

## Lifecycle and cleanup

### Mount
1. Widget renders with `useMapWidgetIds`
2. `onActiveViewChange()` fires on map bind
3. `useCache()` checks for cached gallery element; if found, reuse; else create
4. `createBasemapGallery()` fetches basemaps, creates DOM element, wraps in LocalBasemapsSource
5. `useCustomBasemapsChange()` attached to listen for config updates
6. `updateBasemapGalleryItems()` effect monitors basemapsType and themeMode

### Basemap switch
User clicks gallery item; web component sets `mapView.map.basemap = selectedBasemap` internally.

### Config update
Settings change detected, `onPropertyChange()` saves config, runtime receives prop, `useCustomBasemapsChange()` routes to add/remove/sort handler, gallery updates in-place.

### Map switch
`onActiveViewChange()` fires, gallery recreated or reused, source refreshed, original basemaps restored for previous map.

### Unmount / Widget removal
`widgetWillRemove()` called via appConfigOperations extension: destroys gallery element, clears MutableStoreManager cached state.

## Manifest/config requirements

- `dependency`: "jimu-arcgis"
- `defaultSize`: 320x400
- `properties.coverLayoutBackground`: true
- `extensions`: appConfigOperations (APP_CONFIG_OPERATIONS), builderOperations (BUILDER_OPERATIONS)
- Requires ArcGIS Maps SDK and esri/widgets/BasemapGallery web component
- Config: `{ basemapsType?: BasemapsType, customBasemaps?: BasemapInfo[] }`

## Gotchas

1. **Template switching race condition**: Map destroyed before gallery creation finishes; check `!mapView?.map` before using.

2. **Basemap equality checks fail with ===**: Use `BasemapGalleryViewModel.basemapEquals()` for semantic comparison.

3. **3D basemaps fail on 2D maps**: Filter via `basemapUtils.isBasemap3D()` when `mapView.type !== '3d'`.

4. **Web component auto-destroy**: Set `autoDestroyDisabled = true` when caching and reusing.

5. **Original basemap may not be in source**: Check and prepend with `unshift()` if missing.

6. **Theme mode changes**: Monitor `theme?.sys?.color?.mode` and rebuild gallery on change.

7. **Drag-drop detection**: Use array diff algorithm to detect single moved item position.

8. **Session token required**: `basemapUtils.getOrgBasemaps()` needs portal authentication.

9. **Custom basemap layer URL detection**: Sniff URL suffix (.MapServer, .ImageServer, .VectorTileServer) to determine layer type; ImageServer gets popup handling.

10. **Gallery element cache vs view lifecycle**: Use cleanup function in useEffect to persist state only if widget still exists in config.

### Get org basemaps with cache

const getOrgBasemaps = async () => {
  if (cachedOrgBasemaps) return [...cachedOrgBasemaps]
  const orgBasemapItems = await basemapUtils.getOrgBasemaps()
  setCachedOrgBasemaps(orgBasemapItems)
  return orgBasemapItems
}

### Load basemap with layers
```typescript
const getLoadedBasemap = (basemapInfo: BasemapInfo, theme: IMThemeVariables) => {
  return getBasemap(
    isBasemapFromUrl(basemapInfo) && !basemapInfo.thumbnail?.url
      ? { ...basemapInfo, thumbnail: { url: getDefaultThumbnail(theme) } }
      : basemapInfo,
    Basemap, Layer, VectorTileLayer
  )
}
```

### Create LocalBasemapsSource
```typescript
const getBasemapsSource = (basemaps: __esri.Basemap[]) => {
  return new LocalBasemapsSource({ basemaps })
}
```

### Create portal basemap from ID
```typescript
const basemap = new Basemap({ portalItem: { id: basemapInfo.id } })
return basemapUtils.loadBasemap(basemap)
```

### Create custom basemap from REST URLs
```typescript
const layers = await Promise.all(basemapInfo.layerUrls.map((url) => {
  if (url.endsWith('MapServer') || url.endsWith('ImageServer') || url.endsWith('VectorTileServer')) {
    const params: __esri.LayerFromArcGISServerUrlParams = { url }
    if (urlIsImageServer(url)) params.properties = { popupEnabled: !basemapInfo.disablePopup }
    return Layer.fromArcGISServerUrl(params)
  }
  return Promise.resolve(new VectorTileLayer({ url }))
}))
const basemap = new Basemap({
  id: basemapInfo.id,
  title: basemapInfo.title,
  thumbnailUrl: appConfigUtils.processResourceUrl(basemapInfo.thumbnail?.url),
  baseLayers: layers.filter((ly): ly is BasemapFromUrlLayerType => !!ly)
})
return basemapUtils.loadBasemap(basemap)
```

### Detect 3D basemap
```typescript
const [is3D, setIs3D] = React.useState(false)
React.useEffect(() => {
  getLoadedBasemap(basemapInfo).then((basemap) => {
    setIs3D(basemapUtils.isBasemap3D(basemap))
  })
}, [basemapInfo])
```

### Immutable config merge with defaults
```typescript
export function useFullConfig (config: Partial<IMConfig>) {
  return React.useMemo(() => {
    return Immutable({
      basemapsType: BasemapsType.Organization,
      customBasemaps: []
    } as Config).merge(config)
  }, [config])
}
```

### Generate unique ID for basemap from URL
```typescript
export const BASEMAP_FROM_URL_ID_SUFFIX = '-basemap-url'
export const getIdForBasemapFromUrl = () => {
  return `${uuidv1()}${BASEMAP_FROM_URL_ID_SUFFIX}`
}
```

### Translation keys for multi-language support
```typescript
getTranslationKey (appConfig: IMAppConfig): Promise<extensionSpec.TranslationKey[]> {
  const customBasemaps = (appConfig.widgets[this.widgetId].config as IMConfig).customBasemaps
  const keys: extensionSpec.TranslationKey[] = []
  if (customBasemaps?.length > 0) {
    customBasemaps.forEach((basemapInfo, index) => {
      if (isBasemapFromUrl(basemapInfo)) {
        keys.push({
          keyType: 'value',
          key: `widgets.${this.widgetId}.config.customBasemaps[${index}].title`,
          label: { key: 'label', enLabel: 'Basemap Label for ML' },
          nav: basemapInfo.title,
          valueType: 'text'
        })
      }
    })
  }
  return Promise.resolve(keys)
}
```
````

```text
# OTB Widget: arcgis/coordinates

Online widget doc: https://developers.arcgis.com/experience-builder/guide/coordinates-widget/

## Purpose
```

````text
Display coordinates at pointer position or clicked location on a map/scene. Supports multiple coordinate systems (geographic/projected), formats (DD/DMS/DDM/MGRS/USNG), multi-datum transformation, and 3D elevation/eye altitude readouts. Runtime: real-time pointer tracking or click-to-capture. Builder: configure coordinate systems, units, display order, widget style (classic/modern), and datum transformations.

## Source paths inspected

- Manifest: [manifest.json](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/manifest.json)
- Config interface: [src/config.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/config.ts)
- Runtime widget: [src/runtime/widget.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx) (900+ lines)
- Runtime components: [src/runtime/components/elev-eye.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/components/elev-eye.tsx), [text-auto-fit.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx)
- Runtime style: [src/runtime/style.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/style.ts)
- Utilities: [src/utils/index.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/utils/index.ts) (degree/unit conversions)
- Builder operations: [src/tools/builder-operations.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/tools/builder-operations.ts)

## Architecture overview

coordinates widget
├── Runtime (widget.tsx)
│   ├── JimuMapViewComponent: bind selected map
│   ├── GraphicsLayer: renders location marker

├── Setting panels (setting.tsx + system-config.tsx)

│   ├── Coordinate system list: add/edit/remove systems
│   ├── SystemConfig: WKID input, display unit select, elevation unit, datum transforms
│   └── Display options: decimal places, separators, XY/YX order, classic/modern style
└── Builder operations: BUILDER_OPERATIONS extension for translation keys
```

## Reusable patterns found

### 1. Pointer capture with view event handlers

**Source:** [src/runtime/widget.tsx:189-204](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L189-L204)

```typescript
hooks.useUpdateEffect(() => {
  const view = currentJimuMapView?.view
  const viewTypeIsThree = view?.type === '3d'
  if (enableRealtime) {
    clickListener.current?.remove()
    moveListener.current?.remove()
    moveListener.current = view?.on('pointer-move', (event) => {
      const point = view.toMap({ x: event.x, y: event.y })
      const threeDPoint = { x: event?.native?.pageX, y: event?.native?.pageY }
      onMouseMove(point, viewTypeIsThree ? threeDPoint : undefined)
    })
  } else {
    // ... click handler when locate mode active
    if (locateActive) {
      clickListener.current = view?.on('click', (event) => {
        const threeDPoint = { x: event?.native?.pageX, y: event?.native?.pageY }
        onMapClick(event, viewTypeIsThree ? threeDPoint : undefined)
      })
    }
  }
}, [currentJimuMapView, locateActive, enableRealtime, selectedSystemId, coordinateSystem, coordinateDecimal, altitudeDecimal, showSeparators, displayOrder])
```

**Key insight:** Toggle between pointer-move (real-time) and click (locate) modes. Capture raw page coordinates for 3D hit testing. Clean up listeners on deps change.

### 2. Basemap and view property observation with reactiveUtils.watch

**Source:** [src/runtime/widget.tsx:571-589](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L571-L589)

```typescript
React.useEffect(() => {
  const view = currentJimuMapView?.view
  if (!view) return
  // monitor basemap change
  const watchBaseMap = reactiveUtils.watch(() => view?.map?.basemap, () => {
    (view as any).cursor = 'default'
    if (!view?.basemapView) return
    const baseMapView = view.basemapView?.view
    mapWkid.current = baseMapView?.spatialReference?.wkid
    mapPortalId.current = (baseMapView?.map as any)?.portalItem?.id
    checkBasemapUnitsSetTips()
    checkSystemSetTips()
    resetAllGeoInfo()
    if (markerGraphic.current) {
      graphicsLayer.current?.remove(markerGraphic.current)
    }
  })
  return () => {
    watchBaseMap.remove()
  }
}, [currentJimuMapView, checkBasemapUnitsSetTips, checkSystemSetTips])
```

**Key insight:** Monitor external view state (basemap) changes. Must call `.remove()` in cleanup to prevent double-listeners. Access basemap spatial reference via `view.basemapView.view.spatialReference`.

### 3. Multi-coordinate-system output formatting

**Source:** [src/runtime/widget.tsx:715-780](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L715-L780)

Three parallel display paths based on output unit:

**MGRS/USNG (loads formatter):**
```typescript
const displayUsngOrMgrs = (unit: 'MGRS' | 'USNG', normalizedPoint) => {
  coordinateFormatter.load().then(() => {
    const nlsUnit = unitToNls(unit)
    if (unit === 'MGRS') {
      const mgrs = coordinateFormatter.toMgrs(normalizedPoint, 'automatic', 5)
      setGeoInfo(`${mgrs} ${nlsUnit}`)
    } else if (unit === 'USNG') {
      const usng = coordinateFormatter.toUsng(normalizedPoint, 5)
      setGeoInfo(`${usng} ${nlsUnit}`)
    }
  })
}
```

**Geographic (DMS/DDM/DD, unit conversion):**
```typescript
const displayDegOrDms = (unit: string, normalizedPoint, mapIsMercator?: boolean, outCrsUnit?: string) => {
  let { x, y } = normalizedPoint
  const orderXy = displayOrder === DisplayOrderType.xy
  const selectedSystem = coordinateSystem.find(item => item.id === selectedSystemId)
  const { crs } = selectedSystem
  const defaultUnit = outCrsUnit || getCSUnitByCrs(crs)
  const unitRate = getUnitRate(defaultUnit, unit, mapIsMercator)
  x = x * unitRate
  y = y * unitRate
  if (unit === 'DEGREE_MINUTE_SECONDS') {
    x = degToDMS(x, 'LON', coordinateDecimal, showSeparators)
    y = degToDMS(y, 'LAT', coordinateDecimal, showSeparators)
    orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${x} ${y}`) : setGeoInfo(`${y} ${x}`)
  } else if (unit === 'DEGREES_DECIMAL_MINUTES') {
    x = degToDDM(x, coordinateDecimal, showSeparators, 'longitude')
    y = degToDDM(y, coordinateDecimal, showSeparators, 'latitude')
    orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${x} ${y}`) : setGeoInfo(`${y} ${x}`)
  } else {
    const nlsUnit = unitToNls(unit)
    orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(x)} ${toFormat(y)} ${nlsUnit}`) : setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(y)} ${toFormat(x)} ${nlsUnit}`)
  }
}
```

**Projected (meter/feet/etc.):**
```typescript
const displayProject = (unit: string, normalizedPoint, mapIsMercator?: boolean, outCrsUnit?: string) => {
  let { x, y } = normalizedPoint
  const selectedSystem = coordinateSystem.find(item => item.id === selectedSystemId)
  const { crs } = selectedSystem
  const defaultUnit = outCrsUnit || getCSUnitByCrs(crs)
  const unitRate = getUnitRate(defaultUnit, unit, mapIsMercator)
  x = x * unitRate
  y = y * unitRate
  const nlsUnit = unitToNls(unit)
  const orderXy = displayOrder === DisplayOrderType.xy
  orderXy ? setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(x)} ${toFormat(y)} ${nlsUnit}`) : setGeoInfo(`${toFormat(y)} ${toFormat(x)} ${nlsUnit}`)
}
```

**Key insight:** Route output via unit type. Use `coordinateFormatter.load()` once for MGRS/USNG (lazy load). Handle unit conversion and direction order (XY vs YX) per format. Normalize point and use custom degree formatters (DMS/DDM).

  coordinateSystem: ImmutableArray<CoordinateConfig>  // array of coordinate system configs
  coordinateDecimal: number                             // decimal places (e.g., 3)
  altitudeDecimal: number                               // decimal places for elevation (e.g., 2)

  displayOrder: DisplayOrderType                        // XY or YX
  widgetStyle: WidgetStyleType                          // CLASSIC or MODERN
  mapInfo?: MapInfo                                      // map 1 spatial ref metadata (optional)
  mapInfo2?: MapInfo                                     // map 2 spatial ref metadata (optional, dual-map)
}

  id: string
  name: string                                          // user-friendly label
  wkid: string                                          // spatial reference WKID (e.g., '4326')

  displayUnit: string                                   // output unit (DECIMAL_DEGREES, MGRS, METER, etc.)
  elevationUnit?: ElevationUnitType                     // METRIC or IMPERIAL
  datumWkid?: string                                    // datum transform for map 1
  datumName?: string                                    // human label
  transformForward?: boolean                            // datum direction flag
  datumWkid2?: string                                   // datum transform for map 2
  datumName2?: string

}

## Gotchas

1. **coordinateFormatter.load() is async and must be awaited** - MGRS/USNG formatting fails silently if not loaded. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:728](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L728)

2. **Point.normalize() required for coordinates near date line** - Longitude wraps to -180/180 range. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:867](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L867)

3. **Basemap vs basemapView spatial reference** - Use `view.basemapView.view.spatialReference.wkid`, not `view.basemap`. The basemap object does not expose spatial reference. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:582](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L582)

4. **Marker symbol SVG path is relative to runtime** - [src/runtime/widget.tsx:649-651](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L649-L651) uses `require('./assets/pin-exb.svg')`. Ensure SVG asset exists in runtime/assets/.

5. **Portal ID (mapPortalId.current) switches on basemap change** - Used to route datum transforms in dual-map config. [src/runtime/widget.tsx:583](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L583)

6. **3D scene elevation (z) requires hit test or ground view state** - Use view.hitTest({ x, y }) to get surface elevation at screen coordinate. Camera eye altitude stored separately (UNVERIFIED - [src/runtime/widget.tsx:830-850](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L830-L850)).

7. **Widget size auto-sizing affects text scaling** - TextAutoFit component scales down text if widget height/width < content. Set widgetSizeAuto state based on layout item settings. [src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx)

8. **Datum WKID lookup requires isValidWkid check** - System-config.tsx validates WKID before calling wkidLookup. Invalid WKID resets datum fields. [src/setting/system-config.tsx:85-125](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/setting/system-config.tsx#L85-L125)

9. **Display unit type determines projection path** - Geographic units route to degToDMS/degToDDM/normalize; projected units route to unit conversion. MGRS/USNG route separately (require coordinateFormatter.load()). [src/runtime/widget.tsx:728-780](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L728-L780)

10. **Two-map mode (mapInfo + mapInfo2) requires portalId routing** - Used to apply different datum transforms per map. If maps have same spheroid, datum transforms not required. [src/setting/system-config.tsx:105-125](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/setting/system-config.tsx#L105-L125)

## Useful snippets and functions

### Degree to DMS (Degrees-Minutes-Seconds)

Source: [src/utils/index.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/utils/index.ts)

```typescript
export const degToDMS = (decDeg, decDir: 'LAT' | 'LON', decimal: number, showSeparators: boolean) => {
  let d = Math.abs(decDeg)
  let deg = Math.floor(d)
  d = d - deg
  let min = Math.floor(d * 60)
  let sec = (d - min / 60) * 60 * 60
  if (sec === 60) {
    min++
    sec = 0
  }
  if (min === 60) {
    deg++
    min = 0
  }
  const fixedSec = localizeNumberBySettingInfo(sec, {
    places: decimal,
    digitSeparator: showSeparators
  })
  const minStr = min < 10 ? `0${min}` : min
  const secStr = sec < 10 ? `0${fixedSec}` : fixedSec
  const dir = (decDir === 'LAT') ? (decDeg < 0 ? 'S' : 'N') : (decDeg < 0 ? 'W' : 'E')
  return `${deg}°${minStr}′${secStr}″${dir}`
}
```

### Degree to DDM (Degrees-Decimal-Minutes)

Source: [src/utils/index.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/utils/index.ts)

```typescript
export const degToDDM = (decDeg, decimal: number, showSeparators: boolean, type: 'longitude' | 'latitude') => {
  const tailTag = type === 'longitude'
    ? (decDeg < 0 ? 'W' : 'E')
    : (decDeg < 0 ? 'S' : 'N')
  let d = Math.abs(decDeg)
  let deg = Math.floor(d)
  d = d - deg
  let min = Math.floor(d * 60)
  let sec = Math.floor((d - min / 60) * 60 * 60)
  if (sec === 60) {
    min++
    sec = 0
  }
  if (min === 60) {
    deg++
    min = 0
  }
  const dm = localizeNumberBySettingInfo((min + (sec / 60)), {
    places: decimal,
    digitSeparator: showSeparators
  })
  return `${deg}°${dm}′${tailTag}`
}
```

### TextAutoFit component (scales coordinate text to fit widget)

Source: [src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/components/text-auto-fit.tsx)

```typescript
export const TextAutoFit = React.memo((props: Props) => {
  const { text, className, widgetRect, domChange } = props
  const outerContainerDom = useRef(null)
  const textDom = useRef(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    updateText()
  }, [text, widgetRect, outerContainerDom.current?.clientWidth, outerContainerDom.current?.clientHeight, domChange])

  const updateText = () => {
    const outerWidth = outerContainerDom.current?.clientWidth
    const outerHeight = outerContainerDom.current?.clientHeight
    const textWidth = textDom.current?.clientWidth
    const textHeight = textDom.current?.clientHeight
    if (!outerWidth || !textWidth || !outerHeight || !textHeight) return
    if (textWidth !== outerWidth || textHeight !== outerHeight) {
      const widthRate = outerWidth / textWidth
      const heightRate = outerHeight / textHeight
      textDom.current.style.transform = `scale(${Math.min(widthRate, heightRate)})`
    } else {
      textDom.current.style.transform = 'none'
    }
  }

  return <div ref={outerContainerDom} css={getStyle()} className={className}>
    <div className='text' ref={textDom}>{text}</div>
  </div>
})
```

### Check if coordinate system can display in client

Source: [src/runtime/widget.tsx:654-696](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinates/src/runtime/widget.tsx#L654-L696)

```typescript
const canShowInClient = React.useCallback(async (selectedSystem: CoordinateConfig): Promise<boolean> => {
  if (!selectedSystem) return false
  const { wkid, crs } = selectedSystem
  const curWkidNum = parseInt(wkid)
  const curSr = new SpatialReference({ wkid: curWkidNum })
  const mapSr = new SpatialReference({ wkid: mapWkid.current })
  const specialCase = (mapWkid.current === 4326 && curSr.isWebMercator) ||
    (curWkidNum === 4326 && mapSr.isWebMercator)
  const curLabel = crs?.name
  const usedConfigMapInfo = getUsedMapInfo()
  const hasMap = useMapWidgetIds && useMapWidgetIds?.length > 0
  const getMapLabel = (): Promise<string> => {
    if (!mapWkid.current || !hasMap) {
      return Promise.resolve('')
    } else if (usedConfigMapInfo?.wkid && mapWkid.current === usedConfigMapInfo?.wkid) {
      return Promise.resolve(usedConfigMapInfo?.label)
    } else {
      if (!modulesLoaded) {
        return moduleLoader.loadModule<typeof JimuCoreWkid>('jimu-core/wkid').then(module => {
          wkidUtilsRef.current = module
          setModulesLoaded(true)
          const { getSRLabel } = module
          return getSRLabel(mapWkid.current)
        })
      } else {
        const { getSRLabel } = wkidUtilsRef.current
        return getSRLabel(mapWkid.current)
      }
    }
  }
  const mapLabel = await getMapLabel()
  const isSameSR = curLabel && curLabel === mapLabel
  if (isSameSR || specialCase) return true
  return false
}, [getUsedMapInfo, modulesLoaded, useMapWidgetIds])
```
````

```text
# OTB Widget: arcgis/coordinate-conversion

Online widget doc: https://developers.arcgis.com/experience-builder/guide/coordinate-conversion-widget/

## Purpose
```

````text
Convert input coordinates from one coordinate system to multiple systems and notation formats. Supports address-to-coordinate (geocoding) and coordinate-to-address (reverse geocoding) via ArcGIS Geocoding Service. Optional map binding allows click-to-convert and zoom-to-converted-location workflows.

## Source paths inspected

- [config.ts](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinate-conversion/src/config.ts) - Config, InputSettings, OutputSettings, AddressSettings, GeneralSettings interfaces

- [config.json](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinate-conversion/config.json) - default widget configuration

## Architecture overview

**Runtime (widget.tsx):**
- Extends `BaseWidget<AllWidgetProps<IMConfig> & ExtraProps, State>`
- Wraps `CoordinateConversionViewModel` from ESRI JSAPI
- Optional `JimuMapViewComponent` binding for map-based coordinate selection
- State tracks: supported formats, CVM instance, jimuMapview, output list, geocoding URL, selected input location

**Input flow:**
- `InputSettings` component renders `CoordinateControl` (jimu-ui/advanced)
- CoordinateControl handles coordinate input in multiple formats (DD, DMS, MGRS, etc.)
- Optional address input with autocomplete via `UtilitySelector`-configured geocoding service
- `onInputConversionComplete` callback updates selected location and triggers output conversion

**Output flow:**
- `OutputFormatsDisplay` renders converted coordinates for each enabled output format
- Formats managed via `_outputDisplayInfos` array (tracks configured + runtime-added formats separately)
- Custom address format via `generateAddressFormat()` (address-utils.ts) uses `Format.convert()` and `Format.reverseConvert()`
- Copy-to-clipboard and detail expansion per format

**Configuration (Setting.tsx):**
- CollapsablePanel structure with four sections: Input, Output, Address, General
- Output formats toggled on/off; custom pattern editing via `CoordinateTable`
- Address settings include geocoding service selection via `UtilitySelector`, candidate score thresholds, display options
- General settings control zoom scale and marker symbol (via `SymbolSelector`)

**3. Custom Format with geocoding conversion functions:**
```typescript
// From address-utils.ts L5-76
export function generateAddressFormat (locatorURL: string, minCandidateScore: number, displayFullAddress: boolean): Format {
  const newFormat = new Format({
    name: 'address',
    getConversionStrategy: (): 'server' | 'client' => 'server',
    conversionInfo: {
      convert: (point: __esri.Point): Promise<__esri.Position> => {
        // Use locator.locationToAddress for reverse geocoding
        return locator.locationToAddress(locatorURL, { location: point }).then(response => {
          return { coordinate: response.address, location: point }
        })
      },
      reverseConvert: (string: string): Promise<__esri.AddressCandidate> => {
        // Use locator.addressToLocations for forward geocoding
        return locator.addressToLocations(locatorURL, { address: { SingleLine: string } }).then(response => {
          return response.filter(item => item.score >= minCandidateScore).sort((a,b) => b.score - a.score)[0]
        })
      }
    },
    coordinateSegments: [{ alias: 'L', description: 'Address', searchPattern: /.*/ }],
    defaultPattern: 'L'
  })
}
```
Source: [src/runtime/address-utils.ts#L5-76](ArcGISExperienceBuilder/client/dist/widgets/arcgis/coordinate-conversion/src/runtime/address-utils.ts#L5-76)

addNewFormat = (name, label, currentPattern, addAtTheTop) => {
  let newConversion = new Conversion({ format: /* ... */ })
  const newOutputDisplayInfo: OutputDisplayInfo = {
    displayLabel: label,
    isOpen: false,
    format: newConversion.format,
    addedAtRuntime: true
  }
  if (addAtTheTop) {
    this.state.outputFormatCoordVM.conversions.splice(0, 0, newConversion)
    this._outputDisplayInfos.splice(0, 0, newOutputDisplayInfo)
  } else {
    this.state.outputFormatCoordVM.conversions.add(newConversion)
    this._outputDisplayInfos.push(newOutputDisplayInfo)
  }
  setTimeout(() => this.updateOutputConversions(), 100)
}
```

## Builder vs runtime split

**Builder (Setting.tsx):**
- Uses `BaseWidgetSetting` instead of `BaseWidget`
- Four collapsible setting panels: Input, Output, Address, General
- `OutputSetting` component manages format enable/disable and pattern editing via `CoordinateTable`
- `AddressSettings` manages geocoding service URL (via UtilitySelector or helper services fallback)
- `GeneralSettings` configures zoom scale and point symbol via `SymbolSelector`
- No coordinate conversion happens; UI for configuration only
- Loads JSAPI modules on mount: `CoordinateConversionViewModel, Format, reactiveUtils`
- Generates default supported formats list to show all available conversion options

**Runtime (Widget.tsx):**
- Uses `BaseWidget` with State management
- Only displays configured output formats (unless empty, then shows all)
- Tracks runtime-added formats separately in `_outputDisplayInfos`
- Executes coordinate conversions via CVM.updateConversions()
- Manages geocoding service URL resolution (utility selection, helper services fallback, or direct config)
- Optional map binding and map-click-to-convert via `JimuMapViewComponent`
- Input processing via `CoordinateControl` component with selected location state

## Lifecycle and cleanup

**Component initialization (componentDidMount, widget.tsx L260-264):**
- Set `_isMounted = true`
- If no map configured, call `createAPIWidget()` to initialize CVM without view

**Active view change (onActiveViewChange, widget.tsx L373-381):**
- Called when JimuMapViewComponent receives active map view
- Updates `jimuMapview` state and calls `createAPIWidget()` with new view

**CVM creation (createAPIWidget, widget.tsx L383-424):**
- Instantiate `CoordinateConversionViewModel` with optional view
- Watch CVM.state for 'ready', then pause to prevent unwanted reverse geocoding
- Watch CVM.messages to detect format changes and rebuild output display

**Configuration changes (componentDidUpdate, widget.tsx L273-307):**
- Detect useMapWidgetIds changes: destroy old CVM, reset state, recreate
- Detect output settings changes: same destroy/recreate flow
- Detect address settings changes (utilities, geocoding URL): call updateGeocodeURL()
- Detect displayFullAddress toggle: update address format immediately

**Cleanup (componentWillUnmount, widget.tsx L309):**
- Set `_isMounted = false` to prevent state updates after unmount
- UNVERIFIED: CVM destroy on unmount (not explicitly in code, may be garbage collected)

**Memory management:**
- CVM instances destroyed in componentDidUpdate before reassignment (L282-283)
- `_displayDefaultCursor()` resets map cursor state (L387-393)
````
